goal: From docs/specs/REQUIREMENTS.md + docs/idea/*, produce build-ready DESIGN.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, API.md and TEST-PLAN.md covering every requirement ID, resolved against adversarial Fable-5 review over up to 3 rounds; wire MONSKILLS into a project CLAUDE.md.
preflight: N/A - deliverables are four specification documents, no code written or changed. Forced-decision half executed inline at the gate (FD-1..FD-5).

forced_decisions.FD-1: OD-1 booth sessions: WALL-ONLY today, MON labelled simulated (booth spec section 9, level L1). On-chain via the same relay interface is documented as the stretch. APPROVED.
forced_decisions.FD-2: Adopt the documented 50 rps as the design budget AND keep FR-REL-9 measurement as the first build task. The limit is per-IP behind venue NAT so the real figure will be lower. APPROVED.
forced_decisions.FD-3: Split transport by hop: SSE from the self-hosted relay to the wall (no Vercel 300s cap in that path); polling only where a Vercel function is in the path. Dissolves C6. APPROVED.
forced_decisions.FD-4: Docs cover the full development cycle, with today's 18:00 freeze slice marked inline. APPROVED.
forced_decisions.FD-5: Annotate stale booth-spec items (section 8 single hot wallet, section 15.2 reward) as superseded; do not rewrite that doc. APPROVED.

acceptance_criteria.AC-D2: 100% of requirement IDs appear in at least one downstream doc; every M-priority FR has a named design element AND a named test case, checked against the coverage ledger
acceptance_criteria.AC-D3: All 12 inherited contradictions (C1..C12) resolved in writing with the chosen answer and its consequence, or explicitly escalated
acceptance_criteria.AC-D4: Every Monad number carries a file:line or URL citation; no recalled figures
acceptance_criteria.AC-D5: TEST-PLAN gives a runnable command or an explicit operator script per AC-1..AC-11 and per M-priority FR, with pass/fail thresholds
acceptance_criteria.AC-D6: API.md covers contract functions, events, custom errors and measured gas limits; meter payload and signature scheme; relay HTTP and stream; booth endpoints; dashboard stream - each with examples and error codes
acceptance_criteria.AC-D7: 3 adversarial rounds run (fewer only if a round adds no new material objection), with an objection log tagging ACCEPTED / REJECTED / UNRESOLVED
acceptance_criteria.AC-D8: Project CLAUDE.md exists, names the MONSKILLS routing rule, install verified present
acceptance_criteria.AC-D9: Unknowns Ledger empty at close, or DONE_WITH_CONCERNS naming every open item

contradictions_to_resolve.C1: RPC limit called undocumented in REQUIREMENTS (CON-5 line 141, ASM-4 line 152, FR-REL-9 line 388) but documented in docs/monad_dev_resources.md:141 as 50 rps, 25 rps for eth_call, batch 100
contradictions_to_resolve.C2: 50-session stretch (NFR-P-2 line 519) at 1 Hz = 50 tx/s = 100 percent of the documented rps budget under per-tick (FR-REL-1 line 380). No headroom for receipts or reads
contradictions_to_resolve.C3: The 50 rps is per-IP; venue wifi likely NATs the whole room behind one IP (REQUIREMENTS line 132)
contradictions_to_resolve.C4: Reserve balance: 10 MON floor per EOA, below it throttled to about 1 tx per 1.2s (concepts/SKILL.md:25). Threatens the FR-REL-8 wallet pool (line 387). Absent from requirements
contradictions_to_resolve.C5: Newly funded accounts need about 1.2s before transacting (concepts/SKILL.md:23). Affects pool bring-up and booth live registration
contradictions_to_resolve.C6: Booth spec lines 45 and 381 say the Vercel 300s cap killed SSE and the wall polls. REQUIREMENTS FR-DASH-8 line 412 and IF-6 line 494 mandate a reconnect-safe stream, SSE recommended
contradictions_to_resolve.C7: Booth spec line 438 specifies a single funded hot wallet; FR-REL-8 line 387 mandates a pool
contradictions_to_resolve.C8: Booth spec line 608 lists the reward as unresolved and recommends unconditional; booth line 341 and REQUIREMENTS line 659 both record it decided as conditional 20 percent, table A
contradictions_to_resolve.C9: Gas is charged on gas_limit, not gas used (gas/SKILL.md:14). About 9000 transactions in a 3-minute demo at 50 sessions. No requirement computes the MON burn or sizes the funding
contradictions_to_resolve.C10: Performance figures conflict: monskill/SKILL.md:30 says 400ms block and 800ms finality; docs/monad_dev_resources.md:96 says 300ms and 600ms
contradictions_to_resolve.C11: eth_sendRawTransactionSync exists (monskill/SKILL.md:31) and would remove a receipt round-trip per tick. Unused in every spec
contradictions_to_resolve.C12: OD-1 and OD-2 are open (REQUIREMENTS lines 668-669) but FR-SIM-6 line 399 and FR-BOOTH-9 line 432 have effectively answered OD-2
